name: Bone Defender
definitionRules: Summon an 23 HP / 4 Power Thrall with Defender.
rules: Summon Bone Defender: 23 HP / 4 Power. Defender. Rot starts at 1. Automatically spend Corpses equal to its Mana cost instead if available.
displayRules:
Summon a Thrall. 23 HP / 4 Power.
Defender.
Rot starts at 1.
If you have 2 Corpses, spend them instead of Mana.
